searchText: Will there be an RPC endpoint that gives you the base fee of the next block? atm there is not It seems like a useful method to have. What is the right channel to propose adding one? Interesting. That *is* known information. Yes, as far as I understand it can be computed just with the latest block, right? But it's a non-trivial formula (even if it's not exactly advanced math) and it involves some constants that can change I think this channel is the right place, <@!130156954273316865> but it seems like right now figuring out how to adapt the gasPrice APIs and add PriorityFee are the biggest priority. Perhaps opening an issue or draft PR on the Eth1 specs repo is the way to go? Sure, I don't need this right now, it's just something that turned up while working on our support for London.
